launch: Require explicit full immutable launch commit with both submitted dataset jobs, exact plan pins, original prepared-input pin/selection, resources and separately frozen reader identity. Never admit partial producer output or follow a mutable current ledger.
arms: Every and only the original eligible/applicability arm subsequence plus required canonical/construction/decision/measurement controls from independent pilot admission. Preserve roles and original stopped gates.
admission: Original pilot and preparation must remain independently admitted. Require both inference jobs uniquely terminal successful on16CPU128G on bizon and independently verify nonoverlapping QfO-before-ThreeKingdoms Start/End accounting, source/runtime/tool/driver inventories unchanged, complete checkpoint/FASTA ownership, exact commands/raw resource logs, actual profile/nomination/backend receipts, partitions/constraints/native products/rooted trees, score/reference content and original assessments. Recompute native pair/confidence turnover separately from accuracy.
measurement_control: Require repaired-control graph/candidate/native/tree/coverage equivalence and exact repaired assessment reuse, including pinned receipt, original conversion/metric/reference records and fresh raw-score readback. Never rerun unseeded FAS as a supposed measurement-control replicate.
populations: Recount saved GO/EC numeric scored pairs and rounded means; recount FAS numeric sample and eligible pool separately, repeat native sample arithmetic and report repeated proteins. Means remain conditional on annotation eligibility and unseeded FAS sampling, not orthology F1 or matched-population accuracy.

screen.interpretation: Original development point screen only, not significance, generalizability or default promotion. Applicability/control-only roles cannot become eligible by relabeling a failed pilot.

contrasts: Keep legacy-relative, matched projection-relative and HMMER-minus-builtin effects distinct at every measured endpoint. Repair-only gains do not establish HMMER benefit. Retain stopped/missing/failed results explicitly and contextual tools including OrthoFinder3.1.5 full; no heterogeneous average.
uncertainty: Inherit source-bound original paired OrthoBench uncertainty; do not fabricate paired QfO family intervals or assume independent pairs. TreeFam supporting, Three Kingdoms supplementary. Development exposure, missing independent confirmation, functional population shifts and shared-host cached timings limit claims rather than blocking a documented conclusion.
